name: SHIKANOKO-NETWORKS
notes:
Shikanoko Networks (AS219361) is operated by SHIKANOKO NETWORKS LTD, a UK-based RIPE NCC LIR (ORG-SNL106-RIPE). We provide ASN sponsorship, IPv4 leasing, and IPv6 PA /48 services.

Network: IPv4 2.152.73.0/24; IPv6 2a0a:87c0::/48; IRR AS-SET AS219361:AS-ALL. Transit upstream: AS24961 (WIIT Group). Bilateral peering: AS205058 (peering only; no IP transit). Colocation presence: WIIT, Düsseldorf, Germany (PeeringDB Facility 274). SKNK operates its equipment in leased rack space at this facility. No public IXP connection is currently listed.

Peering policy: Selective. We welcome bilateral peering enquiries for our German node. Settlement-free peering is available by mutual agreement, subject to technical feasibility. Connection method and any transport or cross-connect costs are agreed separately. Peering does not include full Internet transit or a default route.

Send your ASN, IRR AS-SET, intended prefixes, proposed connection method and location, and technical contact to admin@shikanoko-networks.com. Only authorised, agreed prefixes may be announced; IRR, RPKI and session parameters are checked before activation.

NOC: noc@shikanoko-networks.com. Abuse: abuse@shikanoko-networks.com.
Peering information: https://www.sknk.eu/peering
Network information: https://www.sknk.eu/network
